scope: Read-only production aggregates; disposable SQL regression only. No production cleanup or deployment.

productionSnapshot.databaseTransaction: START TRANSACTION READ ONLY; SELECT only; ROLLBACK

serviceSnapshot.mechanism: Enabled campus-api systemd service runs in-process cleanup; no independent gift cleanup timer.
serviceSnapshot.boundary: Cleanup pauses when the API service is stopped; next startup runs catch-up cleanup.

cleanupSemantics.previewNote: Editor renews its lease. ReleasePreview keeps a final 120-second lease, so expiry means two minutes after the last renewal/release.
cleanupSemantics.qualificationRowsRemoved: Unreferenced expired gift_uploads rows, including missing-file legacy records.
cleanupSemantics.physicalDeletion: Only recognized generated files beneath the absolute gift-sites upload root; preserve every live site/preview reference.
cleanupSemantics.failureRecovery: Revoke reusable qualification in the same SQL transaction, commit before unlink, and retry identifiable orphans on the next sweep.
cleanupSemantics.emptyDirectoryDeletion: Owner advisory lock shared with uploads; rmdir only and never recursive user-directory deletion.
cleanupSemantics.sharedImages: One physical uploaded file may serve multiple owner sites/previews; keep it until its final reference is gone.
cleanupSemantics.sharedLibraryAssets: Templates, backgrounds, media, and libraries under server/public/gifts are shared; site creation does not copy a process, package, or asset tree for each site.
cleanupSemantics.backupBoundary: Site deletion does not erase release archives or database/upload backups. They require their own retention policy.
cleanupSemantics.storageBoundary: Deleting MariaDB rows frees reusable database pages; it does not promise immediate filesystem shrinkage of database files.

uploadLimits.conclusion: Unreferenced uploads are reclaimed after the 24-hour editing grace plus sweep delay. There is no per-user aggregate quota, so uploads can accumulate temporarily within that window; sustained/high-volume uploads can still consume storage.
uploadLimits.legacyGifHandling: New gift GIF uploads are rejected before saving; old generated GIF/other-extension orphans are recycled after grace.

rootCauseFixes.issue: Old generated GIF/wrong-extension files, no-file qualifications, and empty owner directories were not reclaimed.
rootCauseFixes.fix: Conservative generated-name inventory, physical reference matching, grace checks, missing-file metadata cleanup, and locked empty-directory removal.

rootCauseFixes.issue: Raw prefix dispatch allowed leading slash, backslash, dot, and Windows absolute/case aliases to bypass gift upload qualification.
rootCauseFixes.fix: Resolve the same normalized physical namespace as the SDK before routing to owner-locked uploadImage.

rootCauseFixes.issue: Publishing acquired upload qualification before consuming preview, reversing cleanup's preview/upload lock order.
rootCauseFixes.fix: Consume preview before validating uploads in the same transaction; errors roll back preview, wallet, site, and ledger.

rootCauseFixes.issue: A reference can be committed while cleanup waits for an upload qualification row.
rootCauseFixes.fix: Check site/preview references again after acquiring qualification locks.

forumReview.currentMechanism: Soft deletion and immediate ordinary uploads; no matching registry or physical-file recycler.

issues.issue: Choosing a photo uploads immediately; removing selection or cancelling a post leaves the uploaded file.
User/admin post and comment deletion mainly set deleted status; content and related collections are not physically cascaded.
Hard/batch/old-post cleanup removes post rows without consistently removing comments, likes, collections, reports, notifications, or image files.
cleanDeletedPosts filters isDeleted:true, while forum deletion writes status:deleted.
cleanOrphanImages reports completion without scanning/unlinking; reported storage use is hardcoded zero.
Image URLs may be shared and replacement does not validate upload ownership or recycle prior images.
Old avatar files require reference scanning across users and historical author/chat snapshots before deletion.

forumReview.proposedApproach: Add module-specific upload registry and ownership validation, decide deleted-content retention, make deletion cascades consistent, then apply delayed reference-aware GC with transaction locks and retryable unlinks. Copying the gift directory scan alone would risk deleting shared/snapshot references.
verificationSuggestions: Disposable database and temporary uploads: cancellation, failed posting, removed selected image and 24-hour grace.
Shared-image references: deleting one consumer preserves the file; removing all consumers eventually reclaims it.
Consistent deletion cascades across ordinary, moderator and batch paths.
Real multi-connection publication/cleanup races, unlink failure retry and already-missing files.
Preserve avatar snapshots and unrelated/external files; reject traversal and unsupported formats.

multiConnectionCases: Cleanup wins: publishing waits for preview before acquiring upload; expired qualification and file are removed; publishing fails normally and restores preview/wallet/site/ledger.
Publishing wins: cleanup initially reads an empty site snapshot and waits on preview; after publication commits, the second reference check preserves the new site's file and qualification.
unsuccessfulTestSetupAttempts: Additional upload-routing fixtures made the gate wait for the wrong file; fixed by running races before upload-routing fixtures.
Initial image fixture omitted required fontSize/color; fixed with valid normalized-layout parameters and early-return diagnostic guards.

cleanupProof.queryScope: Read-only aggregate checks of review DB schema/account prefixes and /tmp test prefixes. Only the owned disposable review stage was removed.

verification.limits: Regression uses disposable SQL and temporary files. Snapshot is the production state before the new deployment.
